variants.name: Exon 19 Deletion
variants.note: no single HGVS form for this kind of alteration

entries.quote: Median progression-free survival was significantly longer in erlotinib-treated patients than in those on chemotherapy
entries.cited_text: Patients older than 18 years with histologically confirmed stage IIIB or IV NSCLC and a confirmed activating mutation of EGFR (exon 19 deletion or exon 21 L858R point mutation) received either oral erlotinib (150 mg/day) until disease progression or unacceptable toxic effects, or up to four cycles of gemcitabine plus carboplatin. Median progression-free survival was significantly longer in erlotinib-treated patients than in those on chemotherapy (13.1 [95% CI 10.58-16.53] vs 4.6 [4.21-5.42] months; hazard ratio 0.16, 95% CI 0.10-0.26; p<0.0001).

checker.reason: The unit describes a randomized trial showing that patients with EGFR exon 19 deletions (a subset of the tested population) had significantly better progression-free survival with erlotinib compared to chemotherapy.
